li.label: Origin: Blade
li.description: This person's origin is the blade, earned through Melee 14, Crafting 12 and the study of five distinct blade types. It is the Trial for the Shirou Echo: a colonist with it can awaken as Shirou at a resonance device. It cannot be rolled at random or lost to a later decline in skill.\n\nAwakening removes every psycast and psylink level and forbids ranged weapons for life, though psychic sensitivity is unchanged.
